title: October 2024 Yokosuka protest at a U.S. naval base supporting Palestine
reason: The captured CIVICUS account says the protest was at a U.S. naval base in Yokosuka and protested U.S. support for Israel. No demand on Japan’s own government or policy is reported; the target shown is foreign-state policy.
notes: CIVICUS was opened in the December unit and consulted here only as an existing cross-month source. Crowd size and exact date are not given. It is excluded on target grounds based on current text, not because no qualifying Japanese protest occurred elsewhere.
